prompt: First frame with labeled foreground GT mask; identical prompt and post-prompt interval across methods; forward propagation, no corrections.

taxonomy.artifact_rule: luminance > 0.95 in >=25% of token area; actual existing analyze_illumination.py rule (the design incorrectly calls it HSV)

budget.k: number of boundary tokens in the selected conditioning or recent bank
budget.insufficient_category: skip and report; never silently lower k or sample with replacement
budget.spatial_match: integer token-grid distance to boundary/foreground support, same counts per distance bin; include reference support and report overlap

pilot.target_sampling: Up to 10 evenly spaced annotated frames from prompt_offset + 7 onward; index-only selection before outcomes.
pilot.memory: c0 oracle spatial masks; object pointers unchanged

gates.E0: zero bias and empty token mask bit-identical to detached controller; independent restored cache bit-identical; full token mask bit-identical to frame exclusion; attention reconstruction max abs < 1e-5; all required
gates.E1: at least one of boundary or near_background has sequence-mean boundary-F harm exceeding the entire five-seed random-control range by >=0.02, or Dice harm by >=0.01; alternatively attention-vs-effect per-frame Spearman sequence mean <0.3. Require all ten sequences and feasible comparisons on >=8 sequences. Otherwise stop/pivot; undefined rank correlation is not a pass. Analyze banks separately; exploratory gate, not a confirmatory p-value.

experiments.E0: instrumentation sanity; stop on any failure
experiments.E1: 10 PolypGen dev sequences, four categories, five random seeds and spatial controls; pilot gate
experiments.E2: PolypGen, CholecSeg8k and DAVIS; attention mask, dev category mean value substitution and cross-sequence boundary swap; single-step and persistent; conditioning/recent; 3x3 query-region matrix; taxonomy sensitivity and size strata
experiments.E3: single-step c0, c1, c2 and natural memory; category x corruption mixed model
experiments.E4: contrast, RAFT-small median motion, artifacts, size and domain interactions
experiments.E5: attention mass and Lean-SAM2 anchor similarity vs matched intervention effect; sequence bootstrap
experiments.E6: training-free deployable-category reliability bias; frozen on dev; PolypGen seq16-23 method test; anatomy/video-level held-out CholecSeg8k and DAVIS val secondary; <=4 primary comparisons; learned head optional

hd95_empty_policy: both empty:0; exactly one empty:null with explicit undefined flag; no artificial finite replacement
data_checks: Report all 23 PolypGen sequences and prompt eligibility; 21 promptable in audited mirror, seq1/seq7 unpromptable.
Kaggle mirror equivalence to Synapse is unverified until content checksums match; report provenance limitation
CholecSeg8k clip indices consecutive; keep source video split disjoint
reporting: Raw rows, skips, sanity checks, protocol SHA256, git SHA, input manifest and checksums, stage status and W&B online run IDs. Later stages gated; never mark whole study complete after E1.

amendment.authorization: User approved documented first-labeled-frame amendment before any token-intervention outcomes.
amendment.unpromptable_reporting: No labeled foreground; excluded from prompted tests, not asserted biologically absent.
